fact: ICT Authority Kenya, a state corporation, says it runs a Network Operation Centre and Cloud Data Centre and designs integrated e-services systems for government.

Murang'a Governor Irungu Kang'ata says AfyaKE, adopted from a national government system, was enhanced by the county's in-house software developers and its staff were trained to use it; the Ministry of Health says it is a private arrangement between the county and its developers.

Makueni County Government says its own ICT directorate gives ongoing technical support to the Projects Monitoring and Tracking System and its in-house ICT Systems Development team built and deployed it.
Makueni County Government says its in-house ICT team built the Projects Monitoring and Tracking System without external vendors and it was launched in March 2024.

Makueni County Government says the Projects Monitoring and Tracking System was developed by the county's ICT and M&E teams without external vendors and is supported by the ICT directorate, with only cloud hosting, SSL, bulk SMS and email hosting bought as services.

Kenya News Agency says the Konza data centre project is implemented by the Ministry of ICT through the Konza Technopolis Development Authority, and the centre serves government departments and state agencies.
